data.description: 【成年星见雅 · 榻榻米软垫的月下独处】成年星见雅独自跨坐厚软垫，深蓝浴衣松至腰间，一手扶腿、一手在腿间自抚，白色狐尾避开四肢。
data.lighting: 和纸灯笼透出的暖黄柔光打在渗汗的玉肌与白狐尾上
data.promptProse: Light crosses adult Hoshimi Miyabi seated alone astride a thick tatami cushion. Her dark blue yukata is untied and gathered below bare breasts while one knee folds on each side of the cushion. She rests one hand on her thigh and fingers herself with the other, her fluffy white fox tail sweeping clear of both legs. Long dark hair, fox ears and blue eyes stay disciplined through a bitten lip and shy flush. Vertical solo portrait, no text or extra people.
